full_prompt_en: A square anime-style painting shows a lavender-haired winged schoolgirl looking upward in warm angled light. The viewpoint is distinctly elevated, looking down on her small figure from above. Her long pale violet hair falls around the cheeks and shoulders, with a straight fringe almost reaching the large purple eyes. She faces slightly left of the viewer and keeps a quiet, serious expression. A white collared blouse with softly wrinkled sleeves and a dark narrow ribbon at the neck catches the strongest highlights. A deep plum pleated skirt spreads around the lower torso, with black legs only partly visible near the bottom edge. Two large white feathered wings rise from behind the shoulders and fill much of the left and right sides. Their layered feathers have gray bases and warm cream edges, with the right wing more brightly lit than the left. The background is a rough stone or paved floor, seen steeply from above; angular bands of sunlight and shadow cross it from the upper right toward the lower left. The pale golden light touches hair, cheek, blouse, and wing tips, while the body and left wing move into cool gray-green shade. Thin clean contours define the eyes, hair, and clothing, whereas the wings and floor are handled with softer textured strokes. There is no horizon, furniture, or readable text, so the aerial angle and broad wings determine the space. The light pattern on the ground forms a subtle grid of bright and dark shapes, giving a physical surface beneath the otherwise fantastical figure. The overall composition is gentle but dramatic, with pale violet and cream forms isolated between shadowed feathers and warm diagonal patches of light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形日系动画绘画呈现一名淡紫发、带翅膀的少女，在斜照暖光中抬头。视点明显升高，从上方俯看她小小的身形。浅紫长发沿脸颊与肩膀垂下，齐整刘海几乎触及紫色大眼。她略朝观者左侧，神情安静而严肃。白色翻领衬衫带轻柔褶皱袖子，领口系窄深色缎带，接住最强亮部。深李子紫百褶裙围绕下身展开，黑色双腿只在底边附近部分可见。两片巨大的白色羽翼从肩后升起，填满左右两侧大部分空间。层叠羽毛根部灰暗，边缘偏暖乳白，右翼比左翼受到更多照亮。背景是一片从高处陡然俯看的粗糙石地或铺面；成角度的阳光和阴影带从右上横越至左下。浅金光触及头发、脸颊、衬衫和翼尖，身体与左翼则退入冷灰绿色阴影。纤细干净的轮廓描出眼睛、头发与衣物，翅膀和地面则由较柔和的纹理笔触处理。没有地平线、家具或可读文字，因此俯视角与宽阔双翼决定空间。地面上的光纹组成微妙的明暗格带，为奇幻人物提供实体表面。整体构图温柔却有戏剧性，浅紫与乳白形状被孤立在带阴影的羽毛和斜向暖光区之间。
style_prompt_en: The anime-style painting pairs precise delicate linework on focal details with softer textured strokes in surrounding masses. Pale violet and cream areas glow against plum and gray-green shadow, while selective warm gold light creates a diagonal rhythm across the frame. Rounded expressive forms retain clean edges near the center; outer edges dissolve into feathered or brushed textures. An elevated viewpoint compresses the space and lets broad side shapes enclose a smaller central form. Light is directional and patterned, leaving clear bright patches but softened transitions across curved surfaces. Fine hair-like lines and layered texture add intricacy without overwhelming the simple overall silhouette. The effect is wistful and luminous, with strong light geometry giving depth to a restrained pastel palette.
style_prompt_zh: 这种日系动画绘画在焦点细节上使用精确纤细线描，在周围大形中改用柔和纹理笔迹。浅紫和乳白区域从李子紫与灰绿阴影前发光，选择性的暖金光则在画面上建立斜向节奏。圆润富表情的形体在中央附近保持干净边缘，外侧边界消融为羽状或刷痕纹理。升高视点压缩空间，让两侧宽阔形状围住较小的中央形体。光线定向且带图案，留下清楚亮斑，但在曲面上的过渡被柔化。细发丝般线条与层叠肌理增加复杂度，却不压过简单的大剪影。整体效果惆怅而发亮，有力的光线几何赋予克制粉彩调色以纵深。
theme_en: A lavender-haired winged schoolgirl looks up in warm angled light
theme_zh: 紫发带翼少女在斜照暖光中抬头
name: Angel Beats
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
